text:
Situation: Palonosetron hydrochloride injection is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. posted a discontinuation on 2025-11-14. Corvale East holds 84 vials of the 0.05 mg/mL, 5 mL presentation with 4.5 vials used per day, providing 18.7 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include palonosetron as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for approximately 19 days. Teva has discontinued. Multiple alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list today.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Apotex Corp. as the primary alternate source; P&T committee to approve addition to formulary if required.
2. Buyer to qualify Avyxa Pharma, LLC as a secondary source; P&T committee to approve addition to formulary if required.
3. Buyer to qualify BLuePoint Laboratories as a tertiary source; P&T committee to approve addition to formulary if required.
4. Buyer to monitor Baxter Healthcare Corporation and BluePoint Laboratories availability; P&T committee to approve if needed.
5. Buyer to track daily usage and update days-on-hand weekly; P&T committee to review at next scheduled meeting.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
